Our story

Different strengths.
One shared standard.

Unique Building Contractors brings together experience in custom construction, remodeling, flooring and fine finishes. Our founders combine their specialties into one team, with one approach to planning, communication and craftsmanship.

We build for the people who live in the spaces we create. That starts with understanding your priorities, and continues through every decision, construction detail and final walkthrough.
